claim_text: Golden and companion bidders coordinated templates, pricing and infrastructure.
Gideon controlled the favoured contractor and shell network.
Hazel documented genuine operational need but did not select vendors or approve invoices.
Change orders increased contract value without corresponding verified work.
Iris identified anomalies and lacked procurement or payment control.
Shell subcontractor funds returned to principals and Pointer Civic Advisory.
Petra manipulated tender scoring and approved coordinated awards and changes.
A material population of hydrants and field certifications was duplicated or unsupported.
